title: Make profile membership years independent of the rendering timezone

source.ref: Full-app golden render failures on Pacific audit host, 2026-10-23

detail: Both the member-grid adapter and the Spotlight/Puck metadata bridge used Date.getFullYear on an absolute account creation timestamp. A 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z profile rendered member since 2023 on the Pacific audit host while the committed reference output and UTC production renderer said 2024. Introduce one pure UTC membership-year seam and use it in both transforms; malformed or absent timestamps omit the year instead of publishing NaN. Two existing golden cases failed before repair and pass afterward without changing the golden files. Forty tests in five profile/bridge suites pass, plus changed-file lint. The standalone consequence probe executes both actual transforms with the real helper and a Date subclass that rejects host-local getFullYear, covering offset crossings and invalid values. No member data or production behavior was read or mutated.

verify.note: Both actual metadata transforms must agree on UTC-year boundaries and missing/invalid dates; any host-local year getter fails the probe.
